hypothesis: Stocks whose latest quarterly earnings beat the same quarter a year earlier by an unusually large amount (high SUE) outperform sector- and beta-matched peers over the next month; large misses underperform.
rationale: Post-earnings-announcement drift: investors underreact to earnings news (Bernard and Thomas, 1989; widely replicated). The effect is reported to be weaker in large caps and in recent decades, so a small positive result is the realistic best case.
decision_rule: If every gate passes: freeze as qualified and shadow-test for 24 monthly rebalances. If any gate fails: close H1. Do not retry other horizons, freshness windows or thresholds on 2018-2026.
